scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm run copy:schema
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && sh -c 'tsc -w -p tsconfig.json & TSC_PID=$!; trap "kill $TSC_PID" EXIT INT TERM; nodemon --watch dist --watch infrastructure/runner/database/schema-versions --ignore dist/infrastructure/runner/database/schema-versions --ext js,json,sql --delay 200ms --exec "pnpm run copy:schema && node dist/app.js"'
scripts.test: rm -rf dist && node --import tsx --test $(find test -name '*.test.ts' ! -path 'test/infrastructure-runner/run-store.test.ts' ! -path 'test/infrastructure-runner/run-publisher.test.ts' | sort)
